title: Quick check: Modern JavaScript Array Methods

questions.prompt: Which statement best describes the purpose of “Modern JavaScript Array Methods”?
options: The concept removes the need to consider error states or accessibility.
The browser will infer all application behavior even if inputs and state are contradictory.
The concept allows application code to mutate React-managed DOM and state directly.
map() should preserve stable identity and render the UI derived from the current data.
questions.answer_key: map() should preserve stable identity and render the UI derived from the current data.
questions.explanation: The correct choice is grounded in Modern JavaScript Array Methods: map() should preserve stable identity and render the UI derived from the current data.

questions.prompt: Which practice is most reliable when applying map()?
options: Store duplicate copies of every value so each component can change it independently.
Optimize by adding every available Hook without measuring the result.
Use stable identifiers as keys and derive visible lists from current data.
Skip validation because a successful render proves that the application is correct.
questions.answer_key: Use stable identifiers as keys and derive visible lists from current data.
questions.explanation: The correct choice is grounded in Modern JavaScript Array Methods: Use stable identifiers as keys and derive visible lists from current data.
